heading: Features
paragraphs: while dining in restaurants, we may have come across some situations where we would like to pay for another customer. The software allows you to combine those bills into one bill.

On some occasions, we may dine out with friends in a restaurant and since we are low on money, we will decide to split the bills so that everyone can pay for what they had. The software also provides the option to split a bill of a table.

In a growing restaurant/hotel, the menu of food items that they serve may change over time. So there is a need to customize the menu items when some new items are introduced or when some existing items are removed. The Software has the master screens that allows one user to edit the item details.
